ValidationRule.description: [Sheet row 52 / OppVR72] Booked Date cannot be changed once Stage is Booked, Setup, Closed or Lost. Approved by IRM, no change.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT($Permission.Sales_Operations_Bypass),
ISCHANGED(Deal_Booked_Date__c),
OR( ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Booked'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Setup'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Closed'), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Lost') ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Booked Date is locked. You cannot update the Booked Date after an Opportunity is Won. Contact your Sales Operations Business Partner for help.
